resolved_semantics: Interrupted assistant output retains exactly the demonstrably heard prefix in ephemeral next-turn dialogue context and excludes the unheard tail.
Interrupted output remains non-commit-eligible for durable VoiceOutcome/UnifiedDB/effect/completion purposes unless separately admitted.
heard_fraction is a playback-progress scalar, not sufficient evidence for an exact textual prefix.

Any partially retained text requires a playback-synchronized transcript/alignment witness bound to the same playout receipt; otherwise exact partial text is UNKNOWN and must not be fabricated from character/token proportion.
Late cancelled-generation assistant/tool data remains causally fenced.

fresh_primary_alignment.finding: Interruption history is aligned to what was actually heard; delayed playback uses explicit playback tracking.
WebSocket interruption truncates assistant audio/history to actual heard playback and emits audio_interrupted.
Interrupted agent history is truncated to the portion actually heard.
PlaybackFinishedEvent exposes playbackPosition and optional synchronizedTranscript; when the latter is absent, the transcript is explicitly not playback-synchronized.

next_exact_action: Trigger4 consumes the existing resolved-policy handoff plus alignment precision, binds the policy id at the existing ephemeral voice/context boundary, requires a sink/playout receipt and playback-synchronized transcript/alignment for any exact partial text, then executes the already-existing HF09/HF10/HF02-HF05 lane through admitted VPS/controller authority. Trigger7 must not create a duplicate dispatch while that boundary is owned or nonterminal.
